messages:
harry: Quick convo starter  should our internal metrics API start returning explicit provenance for percentile series? seeing too many dashboard confusions where p50 > p95 because panel mixes rollup vs tdigest.
leila: absolutely helpful, but careful: rollups currently store coarse histograms, adding provenance has storage and payload implications.
samir: proposal sketch: extend /api/metrics/series to include series-level metadata: prov=(tdigest|histogram|rollup-composite), scope=(region|global), sample_count. Example response (series-level):
```
{
  "series_id": "s123",
  "metric": "latency",
  "quantile": 0.95,
  "values": [[1680000000,230],[1680000060,245]],
  "prov": "tdigest",
  "scope": "region",
  "sample_count": 12
}
```
harry: I prefer keeping payload simple for frontends. series-level prov is fine as phase 1. point-level prov per sample would be ideal but heavier. also prefer short flat keys: prov/scope/n rather than nested meta.
leila: backend note: adding prov field to series responses is cheap. storing per-point provenance in rollups is the costly part. we should estimate extra bytes/point if we add point-level meta.
samir: alternative: series-level + optional change events array when provenance flips over time (e.g. prov_change_ts). that captures migrations without huge per-point overhead.
ui-bot: poll UI-5142 created: "series-level vs point-level provenance". please vote.
metrics-bot: measurement: series-level prov reduces ambiguity for dashboards and is ~95% effective. point-level needed only for long migrations.
harry: operational concern: if a dashboard mixes series with different prov we need the console to warn. UX: show provenance pill in legend and a yellow banner when mixed-derivation detected.
leila: agree. I'll file INFRA-3601 to migrate rollups to tdigest-preserving summaries (longer project) and infra impact analysis.
infra-bot: INFRA-3601 created and assigned to infra-team. estimated 3 sprints for storage migration.
samir: I'll write API RFC proposing v2: /api/metrics/series?v=2 returns prov+scope+n at series level. Clients opt-in via Accept header or ?v=2. backward compatible.
harry: good. also add a dashboard linter rule that flags panels mixing derivation families for same endpoint+metric. prevents accidental confusing panels.
samir: RFC opened: RFC-2026, PR: internal/metrics/rfcs#2026. pinged eng-platform for review. deploy-bot: feature branch metrics/provenance-v2 created by samir.
ui-bot: UI ticket UI-5155 logged: "legend pill + provenance banner + samplecount sparkline". includes mockups.
harry: rollout plan summary: 1) land API v2 series-level provenance 2) update dashboards + linter + console pill 3) run banner experiment on dashboards that mix derivation for 2 weeks 4) infra migration to tdigest rollups (INFRA-3601) 5) evaluate point-level provenance if needed.
leila: will coordinate with infra and metrics to schedule migration windows.
samir: I'll shepherd RFC and add compatibility tests.
harry: thanks all. action items: RFC-2026 review, INFRA-3601, UI-5155, dashboard-linter update. Closing this thread unless someone objects.
leila: +1, thanks. closing.
